requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 DHT11 + 风扇（D5 PWM） + TM1637：显示温度，高于阈值风扇启动
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_3=false with io_1 held at 25.0, then set io_3=true and io_1=31.0 for one control step
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_0 becomes 255.0 when io_3=true and io_1>30.0; io_4 reflects the temperature (floor of io_1); serial_0_trigger is true only on the step where io_3=true and io_1>30.0
